scope: Only explicit qualification-attempt selection and forwarding across the nine public external tools/test. No helper/test/native/build/network execution, source/Git edits or active/private checkpoint/log/config/auth/database reads.
conclusions: qualification_output validates the full40-lowercase-hex subject and explicit first/retryNN closed attempt grammar before constructing the qualification path. There is no newest-directory search, status import or automatic attempt selection.
run_current_checkpoint retains separate qualify-<short>-<attempt> and q-<short>-<attempt> roots with existing fresh-output checks; the failed first corpus is not reused or overwritten.
Unattended and backup use the selected qualifier config/checkpoint; backup's same-owning-profile/identity/receipt guards remain. Their own output roots and portable/headless/build roots remain first.

Index and binder receive the same qualification_attempt. Binder's independent rebuild_index call forwards it explicitly with emit=False, so it does not fall back to first or overwrite the emitted index.
Guide and retainer override only their qualify stage using qualification_output. Other stage roots remain fixed first paths and existing exact receipt/native/archive/source guards remain.

PowerShell validates QualificationAttempt, checks that exact prerequisite checkpoint and passes it explicitly to unattended/backup/index/binder/guide. Portable and headless calls intentionally retain first. The script does not automatically publish the retainer.

The source-only utility test distinguishes first/retry01 and rejects traversal, absolute, malformed and unrecognized attempts and a partial revision. It does not inspect actual attempts or import a passing result.
operational_note: Any later manual retainer invocation must explicitly pass retry01 for this retry. Omission deliberately selects first and fails its prerequisite; it must not silently choose a different execution.
limitations: Parent-reported standby failure, isolated rerun and active retry are context only; no actual evidence was inspected or qualification credit issued.
The active retry remains IN_PROGRESS for this review; failed first results remain failed and cannot be merged with retry subsets.
This is a forwarding/path delta review, not a renewed whole-helper, native, financial-authority or Master acceptance audit.
